name: Shin'uchi Asuka
source: A girl who has numerous incurable diseases... which is actually false. Having been born with a weak body, she once had a cold when she was younger, and through that, she started faking bouts of illnesses. And being truly ridden with an incurable illness, [url=/c28340]Kurou[/url] can't just let this fake girl go so easily.
